text: I'm Daniel and this is What's New in ERU.
ERU MCP brings your endpoint management and security into AI tools like cursor and clawed,
which is where you're already building.
With the MCP, you can five code custom workflows or build dashboards that show exactly what you want to see
and any way you want to see it.
You can connect ERU alongside ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or really any other MCP connected tool
and then build these workflows that span your whole stack.
You've also enhanced ERU AI with the ability to configure Windows apps alongside Mac apps.
And you can now edit a message that you've already sent and have the conversation just pick up from there.
For Windows endpoint management, autopilot features are here.
That means IT can ship a device to a user and that device automatically enrolls and provisions into ERU with zero touch.
We also released a new connector for Active Directory and we added app enforcement dialogues
to prompt users with a five minute countdown when an app gets to its enforcement deadline.
Fewer surprises for end users with apps shutting down on them in order to update and fewer angry notes for IT.
Finally, we shipped improvements for Mac endpoint management.
We've made the endpoint agent tamper proof for all customers and OctaVerify is now available to install as an auto app.
So for all customers already using OctaDeviceTrust, it's extremely easy if they want to switch over
from the App Store app to the new Auto app.
That's everything from last week. We'll see you next time.
